claims.statement: A representative of 'Dutch' Niel said Tom Allen would back Niel against Johnnie Daly in a skin-tight glove finish contest at 149 pounds for $500 a side.
claims.excerpt: representative says that Tom Allen will back ‘*Dutch’’ against Johnnie fora skin- tight glove finish contest, at 149 pounds, for $5u00 a side

claims.statement: Niel said Charley Daly could see Niel at Tom Allen's place to talk business.
claims.excerpt: Niel said yesterday that Daly could see him at Allen’s whenever he wants to talk Dusiness.

notes: The match is only a proposal reported by Niel's representative, not agreed; Allen later denied it (see article 150). Hint's 140 pounds corrected to 149, as printed.
